'''Chiara Saffirio''' (born 9 September 1985 in Rome, Italy) is an Italian mathematician working in kinetic theory and classical and quantum systems. She has been Full Professor of Mathematics at [[University of Freiburg]] since 2025.

== Biography ==
Chiara Saffirio studied at [[University of Rome La Sapienza]], where she received her PhD degree in Mathematics in 2012.<ref name="Eccellenza" />

Later, Saffirio worked as postdoctoral researcher in the [[Hausdorff Center for Mathematics]] at the [[University of Bonn]], Germany, under the supervision of [[Benjamin Schlein]], and as an SNF Ambizione fellow at the [[University of Zurich]], Switzerland.<ref name="Eccellenza" /> In 2019 she was appointed SNF Eccellenza Assistant Professor at the [[University of Basel]], Switzerland.<ref name="Eccellenza">{{cite web|url=https://dmi.unibas.ch/de/news-events/archivierte-news/detail/dr-chiara-saffirio-hat-sich-erfolgreich-fuer-ein-snfs-eccellenza-professorial-fellowship-im-fachbere/|title=Dr. Chiara Saffirio hat sich erfolgreich für ein SNFS Eccellenza Professorial Fellowship im Fachbereich Mathematik beworben|date=24 January 2019|access-date=21 September 2026|language=German}}</ref> At the University of Basel Saffirio was appointed as head of the mathematical physics research group.<ref name="IUPAP" />

In 2025 Saffirio become Associate Professor and Canada Research Chair of Complex Quantum Systems at the Mathematics Department of the [[University of British Columbia]], Vancouver, Canada. In October 2025 Saffirio become full professor of Pure Mathematics at [[University of Freiburg]], Germany.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://uni-freiburg.de/reinemathematik/prof-dr-chiara-saffirio/|title=Prof. Dr. Chiara Saffirio|access-date=21 September 2026}}</ref>

== Research ==
Chiara Saffirio conducts research which lies at the interplay of analysis and mathematical physics. It focuses on kinetic theory, scaling limits in interacting particle systems (classical and quantum), semiclassical analysis and theoretical aspects of partial differential equations.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://chiarasaffirio.weebly.com/|title=Chiara Saffirio personal website|access-date=23 September 2026}}</ref>

== Awards and Honours ==
*In 2021 Saffirio received the [[IUPAP]] Young Scientist Prize "for her important contributions towards the mathematical understanding of the dynamics of classical and quantum many-body systems, leading to rigorous derivations of effective evolution equations".<ref name="IUPAP">{{cite web|url=https://dmi.unibas.ch/en/news-events/archived-news-messages/archived-news-messages/chiara-saffirio-mit-dem-iupap-young-scientist-prize-ausgezeichnet/|title=Chiara Saffirio receives the IUPAP Young Scientist Prize|date=3 August 2021|access-date=21 September 2026}}.</ref> 
* In 2022 Saffirio received an [[ERC Starting Grant]] as Principal Investigator (PI) of the "Advances in Effective Evolution Equations for Classical and Quantum Systems" project.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://dmi.unibas.ch/en/news/details/chiara-saffirio-erhaelt-erc-starting-grant/|title=Chiara Saffirio receives ERC Starting Grant|date=30 August 2022|access-date=21 September 2026}}</ref>
* Saffirio has spoken at many prestigious events as the [[Erwin Schrödinger International Institute for Mathematics and Physics]] (ESI) in [[Vienna]] (2025), the [[Isaac Newton Institute]] (INI) in [[Cambridge]], and the Kinetic Theory, Fluid Mechanics and Microscopic Systems conference in Rome (2026). In 2026 Saffirio was invited as plenary speaker in May conference, an event featured by the [[European Women in Mathematics]] (EWM).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.europeanwomeninmaths.org/activity/maths-in-may/|title= Europen Women in Math|access-date=23 September 2026}}</ref>

== Affiliations ==
* 2019: Group Leader in the NCCR SwissMAP.<ref name="Homepage">{{cite web|url=https://chiarasaffirio.weebly.com/|title=Chiara Saffirio personal website|access-date=23 September 2026}}</ref>
* 2021: Associate Editor of KRM (Kinetic and Related Models)<ref name="Homepage" />
* 2024: executive committee (secretary) of the [[International Association of Mathematical Physics]] (IAMP)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://dmi.unibas.ch/en/news/details/chiara-saffirio-im-exekutivkomitee-der-international-association-of-mathematical-physics/|title=Chiara Saffirio joins the Executive Committee of the International Association of Mathematical Physics|date=16 February 2024|access-date=21 September 2026}}</ref>
* 2024: editor of Journal de l'École Polytechnique.<ref name="Homepage" />
* 2026: delegate of the [[Swiss Physical Society]] for [[Annales Henri Poincaré]].<ref name="Poincaré">{{cite web|url=https://www.nccr-swissmap.ch/news-and-events/news/chiara-saffirio-unibas-takes-new-roles-scientific-and-editorial-governance|title=Chiara Saffirio (UniBas) takes on new roles in scientific and editorial governance|date=25 March 2026|access-date=21 September 2026}}</ref>
* 2026: executive committee of the Association Publication de l’[[Institut Henri Poincaré]], France.<ref name="Poincaré" />
